run_hydra_app: run the Hydra app my_app that prints the resolved configuration as YAML
run_hydra_sweep: run the Hydra app my_app in sweep mode using the example sweeper plugin
review_hydra_config: review the Hydra app my_app and its config files under the conf directory
summarize_my_app: summarize the Hydra app my_app that uses OmegaConf to print configuration as YAML
refactor_my_app: refactor the Hydra app my_app to add custom logic beyond printing the config
